definitions.explanation: Someone who is involved in or connected to a particular matter, organization, or event. Often used to indicate authorized personnel or people with a connection to a situation.

examples.japanese: {関係者|かんけいしゃ}⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧⟦{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}→立入禁止：09542_tachiirikinshi⟧。
examples.english: No entry except for authorized persons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{関係者|かんけいしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I spoke with people involved in the incident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{関係者|かんけいしゃ}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦カリキュラム→カリキュラム：10947_karikyuramu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: According to school officials, the curriculum will change significantly starting next year.

notes:
{関係者|かんけいしゃ} is a compound of ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (relation) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). It covers a broad range of meanings from "authorized personnel" (on signs) to "parties involved" (in news reports) to "stakeholders" (in business).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧⟦{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}→立入禁止：09542_tachiirikinshi⟧: no entry except authorized personnel
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}⟦{各位|かくい}→各位：12042_kakui⟧: to all concerned parties (formal notices)
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧: according to those involved
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask the people involved

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS WITH {者|しゃ}:
- ⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧: person in charge
- ⟦{責任者|せきにんしゃ}→責任者：17175_sekininsha⟧: person responsible
- ⟦{当事者|とうじしゃ}→当事者：12504_toujisha⟧: the party directly concerned

USAGE:
The sign {関係者|かんけいしゃ}⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧⟦{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}→立入禁止：09542_tachiirikinshi⟧ is one of the most commonly seen restriction signs in Japan.
